body:
READ-ONLY exact-candidate review of 586704a. HOLD on two blockers; no edits and no gate verdict.

B5 — durable claim/evidence closure is broken. NarrativeCompilerInput owns the evidence ledger and compiler Provenance (:275-288), but NarrativeCompilation retains neither (:574-586). DerivationGap retains Vector[EvidenceRef] (:119-126; :1326-1334), so a ById reference is dangling once the input is gone. More seriously, accepted ContextAssignment Material metas are put only in acceptedContextBySource and emittedByAddress (:750-768); the derived root-context Evidence cites those ClaimIds as upstream (:880-896, :1300-1323), but the output retains only DerivationReceipt.emittedClaims: Set[ClaimId] (:145-170), not the ClaimMeta values. The resulting durable artifact cannot recover the upstream claim's evidence, calibrated credence, status, or provider provenance. Hashing input.evidence/provenance into candidateSet (:1161-1172) proves identity, not auditability. Repair: retain canonical input Evidence + Provenance and an emitted ClaimMeta ledger (or another closed representation), then enforce that every emitted attempt and every Evidence.upstream id resolves in the artifact. Add a ledger-backed ById test and an accepted-context test that audits the root context's upstream claim after input disposal.

B6 — causal epistemic license is fabricated. Every accepted CausalProposal is materialized as EpistemicStatus.LinguisticallyEntailed (:918-935), but CausalProposal carries only CausalRelation (:32-35), so neither the provider schema nor the deterministic compiler establishes that the relation follows from linguistic form. This conflicts with CausalEdge's contract that precedence never licenses causation and meta.status records how it was licensed (story/relations.scala:78-85). Calibration governs confidence, not evidential kind. For this slice, use the conservative truthful status (likely Hypothesized), or add a typed compiler-owned licensing basis and deterministic rule; pin an accepted causal edge's status.

M1 — fingerprint/equality disagreement remains possible: candidateSet sorts input.provenance.calls (:1170), but materialize preserves their incoming order in ClaimMeta provenance (:1275-1278), and NarrativeCompilation equality includes the draft/resolutions. Reversing semantically unordered calls can therefore keep fingerprint equal while making structural replay unequal. Canonicalize provenance once in Input.of, or declare order meaningful and hash it as such; add the corresponding replay law.

Prior Q1/Q2, trajectory refusal, provider status authority, and honest fixture provenance remain closed.
